title: The Unsaid Undertow
author: Odile Eriksen
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
